stops.note: to search for thoroughly, to win, from com- and quaerere
stops.meaning: to search for thoroughly, to win

stops.note: carried into French for the act of winning territory through force
stops.meaning: the act of winning territory through force

stops.note: settled as the English word for the act of taking control of a place by force
stops.meaning: the act of taking control of a place or people by force

current_meaning: the act of taking control of a place or people by military force
